summary: Recovered the publisher’s Data S1D workbook and compared 13,311 uniquely paired genes. Pearson was 0.95202, Spearman was 0.89977, and 11,520 pairs (86.54%) agreed in direction. Neither author-concordance-v2 numerical route passed. The proposal passed validation, and no ledger was edited.
openIssues: The registered fit retains SPIP19, which the authors excluded. It also uses two groups where the author model uses four. The comparison cannot attribute individual gene differences to either change.
The paper reports five LP and six LPIP animals. The archived code and GEO labels indicate six LP and five LPIP. The authors’ sample-to-design map would settle which assignments produced Data S1D.
